verses.text: "Rule and awe belong to God. He makes peace in the heights of heaven.
Can anyone count his armies? Is there anyone his light doesn't shine on?
How can a person be in the right before God? How can anyone born of a woman be clean?
Look, even the moon isn't bright in his eyes, and the stars aren't pure to him.
How much less a mortal, who is only a maggot, a human being, who is only a worm!"
